data.title: Middle East war, global energy supply, to dominate IMF-World Bank meetings | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The US-Israeli-led war with Iran, now in its eighth month, and the inflation and hardship it has caused will dominate the agenda and sideline conversations during the annual meeting.
